notes: Everything disease-specific the deterministic path needs. Copy this file for a new disease and change the values; the tools hold no disease words. Regexes are Python syntax, matched case-insensitively.

intensive_regimen.meaning: an induction phase holding a pyrimidine analogue (ATC L01BC, cytarabine) plus an anthracycline (L01DB) is intensive chemotherapy, so the population is chemo-eligible

settings.pediatric: pediatric|1 month and older|1 year of age and older|children

indication_roles.transplant_conditioning: preparative regimen|conditioning regimen|prior to allogeneic|before allogeneic
indication_roles.supportive_care: receiving (?:induction or consolidation |myelosuppressive |induction )?chemotherapy|neutrophil recovery|incidence of (?:severe )?(?:infection|febrile neutropenia)|tumor lysis|nausea

excluded_roles.transplant_conditioning: conditioning before transplant, not a primary disease-treatment approval
excluded_roles.supportive_care: supportive care given alongside chemotherapy, not a disease-directed regimen
excluded_roles.follow_on_product: same ingredients, product and setting as an earlier-approved product (biosimilar or reformulation); supplemental to the reference record
excluded_roles.excluded_subtype: indication for a disease subtype that the config treats as its own disease

excluded_subtypes.acute promyelocytic leukemia: APL: ATRA / arsenic trioxide pathway, kept supplemental

pk_probes_note: Drug-interaction probe drugs given in PK sub-studies (usually first-in-human). Kept on the trial as pk_probes, never in a regimen key.
